blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A forest ranger in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) was shot dead Thursday morning in Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, according to the police. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), identified the victim as Ebrahim Sampayan Abdullah, a 59-year-old forest ranger of the Ministry of Environment, Natural Resources, and Energy in Lanao del Sur. He was a resident of Sitio Golf, Barangay Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte.
